title: mcp: the object tools' description says what a field description actually carries
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6948819963, item 1); the filer did not re-read the code behind it. Source: the dev report on PR #34814 (#34721, merged `4771d66a2b`).

## Why

The tool description promises a description "where the author wrote one". On the reference app most of that text comes from columns the platform injects, so the sentence tells a client the wrong thing about where the words came from.

## Evidence

- Per the report: on `examples/app-crm` most `description` values `describe_object` returns belong to platform-injected columns.

## Scope

- The sentence in the tool description states what the field carries: the declared description, the platform's for an injected column.

## Done when

- The description matches what `describe_object` returns on `examples/app-crm`.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34721.
